label: sparse: late original-phase steps in sequences starting with f/b
explanation: Very sparse feature (0.03% of steps). Activation is enriched in the original phase at t=4-6 (70% of mass), and in sequences whose first token is f or b (about 58% of mass), with current inputs b/w/f/1 and previous input 2 also enriched. A smaller share (27%) falls in the copy phase, mostly on steps that output or input f/b early in the recall. It never fires at t<3. No predicate tried got above F1 0.1. Every simple description of the context covers tens of times more steps than are active, so the feature looks like a narrow conjunction over hidden-state contents that these variables do not capture. The recorded predicate is the best simple partial description (dev P 0.05, R 0.19).
